subject: Next steps: Identity intake & security docs for Medsphere evaluation
messages:

Cc: legal@medsphere.com
Date: 2026-12-01T15:10:00-08:00
Subject: Follow-up: Security/SSO questions from today's demo

Thanks again for the demo today — we appreciated the walkthrough of routing policies and the batching controls. A few items Legal and our Infra team asked me to surface so we can move the eval forward: 

- Can you confirm Redwood's current SOC 2 status (Type I/II, date)? Any timeline for Type II completion if in progress?
- We need an initial intake for identity: SSO (SAML metadata or IdP requirements), SCIM provisioning endpoints, and an RBAC admin model.
- HIPAA/GDPR support — high level is fine for now (we'll request specifics later).
- I attached the Medsphere vendor security questionnaire (we'll share a fillable link), but if you can pre-populate SSO/SCIM bits that speeds things up.

Next steps from our side: Legal will send the questionnaire link and our procurement lead will ask about pricing cadence. Do you have someone technical we should loop in for the ID/access evidence?

Olivia Grant
Director, IT Procurement
Medsphere Health

Attachment: medsphere_vendor_questionnaire_v1.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T18:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Security/SSO questions from today's demo

Hi Olivia — great to meet you and your team today. Short recap and ownership so things move quickly: 

Summary answers (high-level):
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type I (security) in March 2025; Type II audit is in progress with a target report date of 2027-02-15. I attached a one-page SOC 2 summary that Legal often uses for intake.
- GDPR/HIPAA: We support GDPR controls and offer HIPAA-compatible deployments (BAA available). We'll surface the BAA template when Legal requests it.
- Identity: We support SAML2.0 SSO (IdP metadata or manual cert + login URL), SCIM2.0 provisioning (tokened endpoints + documented attribute mapping), and a role-based admin model with explicit admin vs. operator scopes.

Owners & next steps: 
- Ben Carter (cc'd) will provide the SAML metadata sample, SCIM endpoint docs, and our RBAC matrix export.
- Karthik Iyer will scope provisioning timelines and any special Admin console controls for Medsphere's needs.
- I'll coordinate uploads to the Drive folder and share a HubSpot link so your procurement/legal can track the intake.

Proposed immediate actions: 
1) Ben posts SAML metadata + SCIM spec to the shared Drive by tomorrow morning PST.
2) Olivia confirms preferred IdP (Okta/AzureAD/OneLogin) and whether Medsphere wants SCIM provisioning enabled during the POC.
3) Legal: feel free to use the attached SOC summary; we'll follow with a BAA if needed.

I'm attaching the SOC summary and a sample SSO metadata file to get you started. If helpful we can do a 20-min technical sync with your infra team — propose 2026-12-03 10:00 AM PST (open to alternative times).

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — tagging onto this thread with the technical evidence and a small set of clarifying questions for Medsphere's infra team. I'll add the files to the Drive folder (links below) and paste a short checklist here so you have everything in one place.

Files I'll upload within 24 hours:
- sso_metadata_full.xml (SAML SP metadata + EntityID + ACS URL)
- scim-api-spec.md (endpoints, bearer token usage, rate limits, attribute mapping)
- rbac-matrix.csv (roles, permissions, admin actions, ability to restrict org-level vs project-level)
- audit-log-export-sample.csv (console admin audit export example, retention notes)

Clarifying questions: 
1) Which IdP will Medsphere use (Okta / Azure AD / OneLogin / other)? If Okta/Azure AD, we can provide a direct setup guide.
2) For SCIM: do you want one-way provisioning (Redwood -> IdP) or two-way? Typical POC is one-way (just create/update/delete from IdP).
3) Any special attributes required for RBAC mapping (e.g., cost-center tags, business_unit)?

Proposed next step: 20-min tech sync with your infra to exchange metadata and validate SCIM test account. I'm available 2026-12-03 10:00–11:30 PST or 2026-12-04 in the morning.

Ben Carter
